issue_request: FHIR-50943 is an Applied FHIR-core DiagnosticReport change request from OO with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked to replace the DiagnosticReport.resultsInterpreter short display 'Primary result interpreter' with 'Who analyzed and reported the conclusions and interpretations' so the repeating 0..* element is not described as a single primary interpreter.
initial_application: The issue was already applied before this reconciliation. Commit 06518d8aef47f5e91b000724d4f981f1bc7eb695 changed source/diagnosticreport/structuredefinition-DiagnosticReport.xml and the matching diagnosticreport-event-mapping-exceptions.xml short-text exception from 'Primary result interpreter' to the approved wording; it was merged by PR commit 9f08b62fe79c92cbc8a78e00042f67ef2ec0b16d.
additional_context: FHIR-49338 is the US Core tracker that prompted the core request; it is Published for FHIR-us-core and directed the same wording update in base FHIR R6 rather than a cardinality change. OO minutes on 2025-05-29 record the ambiguity around 'Primary' versus 0..*, and OO minutes on 2025-06-05 record the Persuasive with Modification disposition, 8-0-2 vote, assignment, and the separate follow-up question about performer versus resultsInterpreter responsibility. DiagnosticReport is in current build scope via source/fhir.ini, and the active StructureDefinition now has the approved short text. A checked-in diagnosticreport.svg still contains definition-like tooltip text, but that is not the authoritative short display and the workflow guardrail says not to publish source fixes that only touch generated-looking SVG artifacts.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build-scope source already satisfies FHIR-50943. The current source/diagnosticreport/structuredefinition-DiagnosticReport.xml short value and the workflow mapping exception both match the approved wording, and no remaining source occurrence of 'Primary result interpreter' was found under source/diagnosticreport.
